answer: Turn every clone into a potential whistleblower: each identity posts a bond, and anyone who proves an identity fake collects part of that bond as a bounty. A farmer's ten thousand puppets are a lantern-lit crowd where each one can betray the rest for profit, so the operator must trust every clone not to defect — and trust does not scale. One exposure sends a ripple through the farm, since a proven fake implicates its neighbours. Cracking a walnut of trust costs the farmer more than the bounty pays. Limit: false accusations need a real proof standard, or bounties become harassment.
